title: Brands - Jansen & Vorster

paragraphs.text: BRANDSWe stock various well-known brands that are personally selected by the Jansen Vorster team. Our main goal is to spend sufficient time with each patient to ensure the correct style of frame is selected. dispensing of spectacles and contact lenses. We strive to walk the extra mile with all of our patients.
